title: Exemption
description: A time-bounded decision to suppress a specific finding or class of findings. An Exemption is not a Control (it does not evaluate a property) and not a PostureFinding (it does not represent an evaluation result). It is a governance decision that alters the lifecycle status of one or more PostureFindings from ACTIVE to SUPPRESSED, with an audit trail of who approved it, why, and when it expires.

exemption_id.description: Stable identifier. SHA-256 of scope fields. Same scope always produces the same ID.

control_id.description: Control ID to suppress. Exact match or glob pattern depending on match_kind.

asset_selector.description: Asset ID, glob pattern, or tag selector depending on match_kind.

match_kind.description: How scope fields are matched against findings.

granted_by.description: Identity of the approver. Email, username, or service account.

granted_at.description: When the exemption was approved. Immutable after creation.

expires_at.description: When the exemption expires. Null means permanent (requires periodic review). After expiry, affected PostureFindings transition SUPPRESSED → ACTIVE.

justification.description: Why this exemption was granted. Must be substantive — 'accepted risk' is insufficient for audit.

approval_record.description: Opaque reference to the approval artifact. Ticket ID, change request number, or document URL.

compensating_controls.description: Control IDs that must be PASS for this exemption to remain valid. If any fails, the exemption is invalidated and the finding reverts to ACTIVE.

status.description: Current lifecycle state. Computed from expires_at and revocation events.
